────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year real (TIPS) yield rose to 2.32% from a trailing-90-day low of 1.78%, a 0.54pp jump as of 2026-07-10.

内容:
10年期实际利率(TIPS)从过去90天低点1.78%升至2.32%，截至2026-07-10上涨0.54个百分点。

Why it matters:
Real yields are the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex bets — a sharp rise this size repriced growth/duration assets across the board and directly raises hyperscalers' cost of debt-funded capex. Crossing 2x the C10 trigger threshold escalates this from a MED to a HIGH liquidity-stress signal.

影响:
实际利率是AI资本开支这类长久期押注的贴现率——如此大幅度的快速上升会重新给成长型/长久期资产定价，并直接推高超大规模厂商靠举债支撑capex的融资成本。触及C10阈值的2倍，信号级别从MED升至HIGH。

Real yields near a decade-plus high sharply raise the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex cash flows and make risk-free debt more attractive than speculative infrastructure bets. alerts.body:
Series:   REAL10 (DFII10)
Date:     2026-07-07
Current:  2.30%
90d low:  1.72%
Move:     +58bp off 90d-low (fire ≥ +40bp)

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
What this means:
The 10-year TIPS real yield jumped to 2.30% on 2026-07-07, up 0.58pp from its trailing-90-day low of 1.72%, crossing C10's 2x escalation trigger.

内容:
10年期 TIPS 实际收益率在 2026-07-07 升至 2.30%，较过去 90 天低点 1.72% 上升了 0.58 个百分点，触发了 C10 的 2 倍升级阈值。

Why it matters:
Rising real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex cash flows and tighten financial conditions broadly — this is the kind of move that historically precedes de-rating of high-multiple growth names, including hyperscalers funding the buildout.

影响:
实际收益率上升会提高 AI capex 长久期现金流的贴现率，同时收紧整体金融条件——历史上这类走势往往是高估值成长股（包括为算力建设融资的大型科技公司）估值回调的前兆。

内容:
10年期TIPS实际收益率在2026-07-06升至2.24%，较过去90天低点1.72%上升了0.52个百分点。

Rising real yields raise the discount rate on long-duration AI-capex cash flows and tighten financial conditions broadly — a fast spike like this pressures the same high-multiple, capex-heavy names the bubble-stress thesis is watching, and pairs with a stronger dollar as a tightening signal.

实际收益率快速上升会提高对AI资本开支这类长久期现金流的贴现率，同时收紧整体金融环境——这类急速飙升会给高估值、重资本开支的公司带来压力，也往往与美元走强一起构成收紧信号。
